title: Autumn Classics & Coffee
description: Start the morning with pre-war favorites and polished weekend cruisers. Coffee stands and a local bakery will be open beside the display field.

title: Coastal Cruise-In
description: An easygoing evening meet for custom builds and modern performance cars, ending with a sunset drive along the waterfront.

title: Electric Auto Showcase
description: See electric classics and current EVs together, with owner Q&A sessions and a short demonstration loop throughout the day.

title: Vintage Truck Gathering
description: A family-friendly display of restored work trucks and utility vehicles. Food vendors will be set up near the club registration tent.

title: Trackside Performance Day
description: Meet local performance-car owners and watch scheduled exhibition laps from the spectator areas. Track access and driving are managed by the venue.

title: Winter Motoring Social
description: An indoor-season gathering for collectors and enthusiasts, featuring preserved road cars, restoration displays, and a community parts table.
